editorial:
Imagine heading out on a school trip with your friends to an old, creepy military base. That is exactly where you find yourself in this flick. You follow five college students who think they are just doing a project, but they end up waking up a secret weapon that was never meant to be found. The vibe is very tense from the start, making you feel like something is lurking around every corner. It feels like one of those classic scary movies where the characters make bad choices, but it keeps you hooked because you want to see what the monster actually looks like.

The action picks up quickly, and the scares are solid. While some of the acting is a bit stiff, the suspense makes up for it. You will love the fast pace, though some parts might feel a bit repetitive if you have seen too many monster movies. If you want the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the dark details. You could also rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a great pick if you enjoy low-budget sci-fi with a scary twist.
endingExplained: At the end, you see that the secret weapon is an unstoppable killing machine. Most of the group gets picked off one by one as they try to escape the base. The final survivor realizes that there is no way to actually stop the creature. It ends on a dark note, showing that the weapon is now loose and will likely keep hunting, leaving you with a feeling that nobody is truly safe.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves monster movies and creepy abandoned places.
